item.title: ACCIDENTAL SHOOTING AT GUN RANGE
item.description: 6:40PM-EMS AND FIRE ARE ON THE SCENE OF A MALE WHO ACCIDENTALLY SHOT HIMSELF IN THE LEG AT THE THUNDER GUN RANGE IN THE 17200 BLOCK OF FM 1314. HE IS IN STABLE CONDITION.

item.title: Traffic Alert: I-45 SB ML – South County – Wrecks
item.description: 7:10 p.m. I-45 southbound main lanes are a mess right now from north of Nursery Road all the way to the Hardy Toll Road. There appears to be three separate crashes causing the issue. Take an alternate route to avoid delays
